page: Microsoft Azure E48ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the EADSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7763 processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.525 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Additionally, it includes 1843 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage.

In benchmark evaluations, the E48ads_v5 demonstrates strong CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core metrics placing in the top 25 percent. Cryptographic capabilities are also robust, as evidenced by a strong PassMark encryption score of 51420.58, aided by hardware-accelerated AES and VAES instruction sets. Memory performance is solid, with a PassMark memory score in the top 25 percent, though uncached large-block memory read and write bandwidths remain in the average tier. Multi-threaded decompression and image processing tasks also show strong performance, while database operations and Redis SET benchmarks perform at average levels.

Given its high memory density and dedicated AMD EPYC cores, the E48ads_v5 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. The inclusion of a large 1843 GB local SSD provides high-speed temporary storage, reducing the need for external storage attachments for scratch space. This configuration is well-suited for memory-intensive applications, relational databases, large-scale data processing, and enterprise workloads requiring significant memory capacity per vCPU.
